sections.heading: Understand operations before changing them
sections.body:
The Digital Twin Suite brings reusable virtual models to assets and operations. A digital twin connects a model of an asset or process with operational data, helping teams understand current conditions and explore possible changes.

Use the suite to assess equipment failure risk, simulate forecasts, optimise inventory and monitor operations in real time. Keep the model grounded in the data and constraints of your environment so its outputs support practical decisions.

sections.heading: Simulation and insight for everyday operations

cards.title: Equipment failure prediction
cards.description: Use equipment condition and operating patterns to assess failure risk and inform maintenance priorities.

cards.title: Forecasting simulation
cards.description: Explore different operating assumptions in a virtual model to understand possible outcomes before changing live operations.

cards.title: Inventory optimisation
cards.description: Model demand, stock and replenishment constraints to inform inventory decisions and balance availability with stock levels.

cards.title: Real-time monitoring
cards.description: Connect live operational data to the twin so teams can review current conditions and identify changes that need attention.

sections.heading: Build a twin around the decisions that matter

items.description: Choose the asset or process to model and define the operational question the twin should help answer.
Connect relevant condition, inventory or process data and reflect the constraints of the real environment.
Check the model against observed behaviour, then explore scenarios and review their operational implications.
Use monitoring and model outputs to support decisions, updating the twin as assets and operating conditions change.
